method: Controller directly inspected captured official JSON fields, XLSX worksheet XML cells without the native permit parser, flare HTML/XML table cells, and six retained RRC raw segments. No requests or database writes by this comparison.
observations: Austin six permit identifiers, sites, descriptions, source issue/status dates and source-listed contractor fields agree with captured original fields. Publication date is not inferred from issue/status dates.

All twelve Dallas/Houston sampled permit identifiers, sites, scope, row locations and source date cells agree. Dallas ContactType=Applicant and LPBusinessName are organization involvement, not prime contract or purchasing authority.

El Paso BCNN25-00099 query returns three GIS features at two addresses and two issue dates. Evidence uses a latest-dated address; source identifier uniqueness and cross-site grouping remain ambiguous. This is not missing-record proof.
Sparse El Paso descriptions/owners/status remain unknown. GISStatus=M is geocoding status, not evidence of permit completion or active work.
Two fresh flare rows support submitted application, operator, lease/permit and district only. Four retained flare originals were outside the bounded three-day route and could not be corroborated.

Austin 2026-037732 BP source explicitly describes like-kind UPS replacement in an existing business building; current rejection may miss a continuity investigation candidate. It supplies no MW, confirmed gap or temporary-power demand. 7DAY is not treated as a power duration.
Raw master-permit identifiers and available coordinates can support subsequent grouping investigation; omission from an abstract alone does not establish a duplicate defect.
request_metadata_limit: Builder comparison captured 25 response payloads; RRC flare initial GET metadata/body were not captured. HTTP numeric status is UNKNOWN because bounded reader returns headers/body without status. No repeated requests to repair metadata.
limits: Source fidelity observations only, not 32 fully correct commercial opportunities, fresh drilling acquisition, owner acceptance, qualification promotion, deployment or a complete recall denominator. Fixed sample and unknown members remain in the builder report.
